title: repro run records --instance-usd in run.json with its other settings
goal: bench_repro.run writes the instance cap (instance_usd) into run.json beside area_usd and max_turns, so a report that states a run's settings as the run recorded them can read every one of them (SP-a3w7xdij: research-repro.md took 58 from the brief, and the review found the sentence beside it wrong)

run:
import inspect,sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bench_repro as b
L=[l for l in inspect.getsource(b.run).splitlines() if 'note = {k: opts[k]' in l];print(L);sys.exit(0 if L and 'instance_usd' in L[0] else 1)
